message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `length_at` function in the CFFIndex can return a huge value when offsets are malformed (offset_at(index+1) < offset_at(index)). This causes the ByteStr to have a huge length, which can lead to out-of-bounds reads during sanitization/interpretation. But the double-free specifically happens in the vector fini.

Let me look at the test cases that were added:
